readings.title: The Exclusive Father and Redeemer
readings.subtitle: Acknowledging YeHoVaH’s eternal Name and authority over the tribes.
readings.text: [Isaiah 63:15] Look down from the heavens, and see from Your set-apart and comely dwelling. Where are Your ardour and Your might, the stirring of Your inward parts and Your compassion toward me? Are they withheld? [16] For <dn>You</dn> are our Father, though Aḇraham does not know us, and Yisra’ěl does not recognise us. <dn>You</dn>, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, are our Father, our Redeemer – Your Name is from of old.

readings.title: The Adversarial Treading of the Set-Apart Place
readings.subtitle: A plea for restorative justice when the inheritance appears lost to those without His Name.
readings.text: [Isaiah 63:17] O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, why do <dn>You</dn> make us stray from Your ways, and harden <dn>את</dn> our heart from Your fear? Turn back, for the sake of Your servants, the tribes of Your inheritance. [18] For a little while Your set-apart people possessed it – our adversaries have trodden down <dn>את</dn> Your set-apart place. [19] We have become like those over whom <dn>You</dn> never ruled – Your Name is not called on them!

readings.title: Rent Heavens and Shaken Mountains
readings.subtitle: Appealing for the visible manifestation of the Creator's power against adversarial systems.
readings.text: [Isaiah 64:1] Oh, that <dn>You</dn> would tear <dn>את</dn> the heavens open, come down, that mountains shall shake before <dn>You</dn> – [2] as when fire burns twigs, as fire makes water boil – to make <dn>את</dn> Your Name known to Your adversaries, so that nations tremble before <dn>You</dn>. [3] When <dn>You</dn> did awesome matters, which we did not expect, <dn>You</dn> came down, mountains did shake before <dn>You</dn>! [4] Since the beginning of the ages they have not heard nor perceived by the ear, nor has the eye seen any <dn>Elohim</dn> besides <dn>You</dn>, who acts for those who wait for <dn>Him</dn>.

readings.title: The Illusion of Fleshly Righteousness
readings.subtitle: Recognizing that superficial obedience amounts to filthy rags without true submission.
readings.text: [Isaiah 64:5] <dn>You</dn> shall meet him who rejoices and does righteousness, who remembers <dn>You</dn> in Your ways. See, <dn>You</dn> were wroth when we sinned in them a long time. And should we be saved? [6] And all of us have become as one unclean, and all our righteousnesses are as soiled rags. And all of us fade like a leaf, and our crookednesses, like the wind, have taken us away. [7] And there is no one who calls on Your Name, who stirs himself up to be strengthened in <dn>You</dn>; for <dn>You</dn> have hidden Your face from us, and have consumed us because of our crookednesses.

readings.title: The Potter’s Clay and the Ruined House
readings.subtitle: An appeal to the Master Architect's covenant over the desolation of Yerushalayim.
readings.text: [Isaiah 64:8] And now, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dn>You</dn> are our Father. We are the clay, and <dn>You</dn> our potter. And we are all the work of Your hand. [9] Do not be wroth, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, nor remember crookedness forever. See, please look, all of us are Your people! [10] Your set-apart cities have become a wilderness, Tsiyon has become a wilderness, Yerushalayim a waste. [11] Our set-apart and comely House, where our fathers praised <dn>You</dn>, has been burned up with fire. And all that we treasured has become a ruin. [12] In view of all this, would <dn>You</dn> restrain Yourself, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>? Would <dn>You</dn> keep silent and afflict us beyond measure?

readings.title: The Provocation of Pagan Traditions
readings.subtitle: YeHoVaH responds to a stubborn people consuming unclean biology and embracing Babylon's rituals.
readings.text: [Isaiah 65:1] <dq><dn>I</dn> have let <dn>Myself</dn> be inquired of, not by those who asked; <dn>I</dn> was found, not by those who sought <dn>Me</dn>. <dn>I</dn> said, ‘Here <dn>I</dn> am, here <dn>I</dn> am,’ to a nation not calling on <dn>My</dn> Name.</dq> [2] <dq><dn>I</dn> have held out <dn>My</dn> hands all day long to a stubborn people, who walk in a way that is not good, after their own thoughts;</dq> [3] <dq>the people who provoke <dn>Me</dn> continually to <dn>My</dn> face, who slaughter in gardens, and burn incense on slaughter-places of brick;</dq> [4] <dq>who sit among the burial-sites, and spend the night in secret places, who eat flesh of pigs, and the broth of unclean meat is in their pots,</dq> [5] <dq>who say, ‘Keep to yourself, do not come near me, for <dn>I</dn> am set-apart to you!’ These are smoke in <dn>My</dn> nostrils, a fire that burns all day.</dq>

readings.title: The Divine Measurement of Systemic Iniquity
readings.subtitle: The strict extraction of justice for those who rejected the authorized structure for localized idolatry.
readings.text: [Isaiah 65:6] <dq>See, it is written before <dn>Me</dn>: <dn>I</dn> am not silent, but shall repay, and <dn>I</dn> shall repay into their bosom,</dq> [7] <dq>your crookednesses and the crookednesses of your fathers together,”</dq> said <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>“who burned incense on the mountains and reproached <dn>Me</dn> on the hills. And <dn>I</dn> shall measure their former work into their bosom.”</dq>

readings.title: The Preservation of the True Seed
readings.subtitle: Extracting the faithful remnant of Ya‛aqoḇ who actively seek His structural harmony.
readings.text: [Isaiah 65:8] Thus said <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>“As the new wine is found in the cluster, and one shall say, ‘Do not destroy it, for there is blessing in it,’ so <dn>I</dn> do for <dn>My</dn> servants’ sake, not to destroy them all.</dq> [9] <dq>And <dn>I</dn> shall bring forth <dn>את</dn> a seed from Ya‛aqoḇ, and from Yehuḏah <dn>את</dn> an heir of <dn>My</dn> mountains. And <dn>My</dn> chosen ones shall inherit it, and <dn>My</dn> servants dwell there.</dq> [10] <dq>And Sharon shall be a fold of flocks, and the Valley of Aḵor a place for herds to lie down, for <dn>My</dn> people who have sought <dn>Me</dn>.</dq>

readings.title: The Allotment of the Sword
readings.subtitle: The catastrophic consequence of preparing a table for pagan deities and rejecting the Creator's decrees.
readings.text: [Isaiah 65:11] <dq>But you are those who forsake <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, who forget <dn>My</dn> set-apart mountain, who prepare <dn>את</dn> a table for Gad, and who fill <dn>את</dn> a drink offering for Meni.</dq> [12] <dq>And <dn>I</dn> shall allot <dn>את</dn> you to the sword, and let you all bow down to the slaughter, because <dn>I</dn> called and you did not answer, <dn>I</dn> spoke and you did not hear, and you did evil before <dn>My</dn> eyes and chose that in which <dn>I</dn> did not delight.”</dq>

readings.title: The Distinction of the True Servants
readings.subtitle: The ultimate paradigm shift where the faithful inherit truth while the rebellious inherit shame and death.
readings.text: [Isaiah 65:13] Therefore thus said the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>“See, <dn>My</dn> servants eat, but you hunger; see, <dn>My</dn> servants drink, but you thirst; see, <dn>My</dn> servants rejoice, but you are put to shame;</dq> [14] <dq>see, <dn>My</dn> servants sing for joy of heart, but you cry for sorrow of heart, and wail for breaking of spirit.</dq> [15] <dq>And you shall leave <dn>את</dn> your name as a curse to <dn>My</dn> chosen, for the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> shall put you to death, and call <dn>את</dn> <dn>His</dn> servants by another name,</dq> [16] <dq>so that he who blesses himself in the earth does bless himself in the <dn>Elohim</dn> of truth. And he who swears in the earth does swear by the <dn>Elohim</dn> of truth. Because the former distresses shall be forgotten, and because they shall be hidden from <dn>My</dn> eyes.</dq>

readings.title: Architecture of the New Heavens and Earth
readings.subtitle: YeHoVaH guarantees a profound structural reset, permanently removing the disharmony of weeping.
readings.text: [Isaiah 65:17] <dq>For look, <dn>I</dn> am creating <dn>את</dn> new heavens and <dn>את</dn> a new earth, and the former shall not be remembered, nor come to heart.</dq> [18] <dq>But be glad and rejoice forever in what <dn>I</dn> create; for look, <dn>I</dn> create <dn>את</dn> Yerushalayim a rejoicing, and <dn>את</dn> her people a joy.</dq> [19] <dq>And <dn>I</dn> shall rejoice in Yerushalayim, and shall joy in <dn>My</dn> people, and let the voice of weeping no more be heard in her, nor the voice of crying.</dq>

readings.title: The Restored Biological Apex
readings.subtitle: A return to the absolute functional harmony of Eden, where labor is fruitful and predatory biology is neutralized.
readings.text: [Isaiah 65:20] <dq>No more is an infant from there going to live but a few days, nor an old man who does not complete his days, for the youth dies one hundred years old, but the sinner being one hundred years old shall be lightly esteemed.</dq> [21] <dq>And they shall build houses and inhabit them, and plant vineyards and eat their fruit.</dq> [22] <dq>They shall not build and another inhabit; they shall not plant and another eat. For the days of <dn>My</dn> people are going to be as the days of a tree, and <dn>My</dn> chosen ones outlive the work of their hands.</dq> [23] <dq>They shall not labour in vain, nor bring forth children for trouble. For they are the seed of the blessed of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and their offspring with them.</dq> [24] <dq>And it shall be that before they call, <dn>I</dn> answer. And while they are still speaking, <dn>I</dn> hear.</dq> [25] <dq>Wolf and lamb feed together, a lion eats straw as an ox, and dust is the snake’s food. They shall do no evil, nor destroy in all <dn>My</dn> set-apart mountain,”</dq> said <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.

readings.title: The Uncontainable Creator and the Contrite Vessel
readings.subtitle: YeHoVaH establishes that His localized rest is found in those who strictly tremble at His Word.
readings.text: [Isaiah 66:1] Thus said <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>“The heavens are <dn>My</dn> throne, and the earth is <dn>My</dn> footstool. Where is this house that you build for <dn>Me</dn>? And where is this place of <dn>My</dn> rest?</dq> [2] <dq>And <dn>את</dn> all these <dn>My</dn> hand has made, and all these that exist,”</dq> declares <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. <dq>“Yet to such a one <dn>I</dn> look: on him who is poor and bruised of spirit, and who trembles at <dn>My</dn> Word.</dq>

readings.title: The Abomination of Syncretic Sacrifice
readings.subtitle: Declaring ritualistic offerings entirely void and repulsive when merged with pagan traditions.
readings.text: [Isaiah 66:3] <dq>But whoever slays <dn>את</dn> the bull strikes a man; whoever slaughters <dn>את</dn> the lamb breaks <dn>את</dn> a dog’s neck; whoever brings <dn>את</dn> a grain offering – pig’s blood; whoever burns <dn>את</dn> incense blesses an idol. Indeed, they have chosen their own ways, and their being delights in their abominations.</dq> [4] <dq><dn>I</dn> shall also choose <dn>את</dn> their punishments, and bring <dn>את</dn> their fears on them. Because <dn>I</dn> called, but no one answered. <dn>I</dn> spoke and they did not hear, and they did evil before <dn>My</dn> eyes, and chose what was displeasing to <dn>Me</dn>.”</dq>

readings.title: The Sudden Delivery of Tsiyon
readings.subtitle: The rapid and miraculous birth of the restored nation, confounding the adversarial brothers.
readings.text: [Isaiah 66:5] Hear the Word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, you who tremble at <dn>His</dn> Word, <dq>“Your brothers who hate you, who cast you out for <dn>My</dn> Name’s sake, said, ‘Let <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> be esteemed, so that we see your joy.’ But they are put to shame.”</dq> [6] <dq>“A roaring sound from the city, a voice from the Hěḵal, the voice of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, repaying <dn>His</dn> enemies!</dq> [7] <dq>Before she laboured, she gave birth; before a pain came to her, she was delivered of a male child.</dq> [8] <dq>Who has heard the like of this? Who has seen the like of these? Is a land brought forth in one day? Is a nation born at once? For as soon as Tsiyon laboured, she gave birth to her children.</dq> [9] <dq>Shall <dn>I</dn> bring to birth, and not give delivery?”</dq> says <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. <dq>“Shall <dn>I</dn> who give delivery restrain birth?”</dq> said your <dn>Elohim</dn>.

readings.title: The Overflowing Esteem of Yerushalayim
readings.subtitle: The profound motherly comfort and peace strictly allotted to those who mourned for the Set-Apart City.
readings.text: [Isaiah 66:10] <dq>Rejoice with Yerushalayim, and be glad with her, all you who love her; rejoice greatly with her, all you who mourn for her;</dq> [11] <dq>so that you feed, and shall be satisfied with the breast of her comforts, so that you drink deeply, and shall delight yourselves in her overflowing esteem.”</dq> [12] For thus said <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>“See, <dn>I</dn> am extending peace to her like a river, and the esteem of the nations like a flowing stream. And you shall feed; you shall be carried on the side, and be fondled on her knees.</dq> [13] <dq>As one whom his mother comforts, so <dn>I</dn> comfort you. And in Yerushalayim you are comforted.”</dq> [14] <dq>And you shall see, and your heart shall rejoice, and your bones flourish as tender grass. And the hand of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> shall be known to <dn>His</dn> servants, and <dn>His</dn> displeasure to <dn>His</dn> enemies.</dq>

readings.title: The Consuming Fire of True Justice
readings.subtitle: The complete eradication of those who defile the biological and spiritual framework with unclean abominations.
readings.text: [Isaiah 66:15] <dq>For look, <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> comes with fire and with <dn>His</dn> chariots, like a whirlwind, to render <dn>His</dn> displeasure with burning, and <dn>His</dn> rebuke with flames of fire.</dq> [16] <dq>For by fire and by <dn>His</dn> sword <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> shall judge all flesh, and the slain of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> shall be many –</dq> [17] <dq>those who set themselves apart and cleanse themselves at the gardens after ‘one’ in the midst, eating flesh of pigs and the abomination and the mouse, are snatched away, together,”</dq> declares <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.

readings.title: The Global Reclaiming of the True Seed
readings.subtitle: Establishing the final sign and reclaiming the scattered brethren to minister at the Set-Apart Mountain.
readings.text: [Isaiah 66:18] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn>, because of their works and their imaginations, am coming to gather all nations and tongues. And they shall come and see <dn>My</dn> esteem.</dq> [19] <dq>And <dn>I</dn> shall set <dn>את</dn> a sign among them, and shall send <dn>את</dn> some of those who escape to the nations – Tarshish and Pul and Luḏ, who draw the bow, and Tuḇal and Yavan, the coastlands afar off who have not heard <dn>My</dn> report nor seen <dn>My</dn> esteem. And they shall declare <dn>My</dn> esteem among the nations.</dq> [20] <dq>And they shall bring <dn>את</dn> all your brothers as an offering to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> out of all the nations, on horses and in chariots and in litters, on mules and on camels, to <dn>My</dn> set-apart mountain Yerushalayim,”</dq> declares <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>“as the children of Yisra’ěl bring <dn>את</dn> an offering in a clean vessel into the House of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq> [21] <dq>And from them too <dn>I</dn> shall take for priests – for Lěvites,”</dq> declares <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.

readings.title: The Eternal Sign and the Ash of the Wicked
readings.subtitle: The perpetual cycles of the Appointed Times, contrasting the enduring seed against the complete annihilation of the rebellious.
readings.text: [Isaiah 66:22] <dq>For as the new heavens and the new earth that <dn>I</dn> make stand before <dn>Me</dn>,”</dq> declares <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dq>“so your seed and your name shall stand.</dq> [23] <dq>And it shall be that from New moon to New moon, and from Sabbath to Sabbath, all flesh shall come to worship before <dn>Me</dn>,”</dq> declares <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [24] <dq>And they shall go forth and look upon the corpses of the men who have transgressed against <dn>Me</dn>. For their worm shall not die, and their fire not be quenched. And they shall be repulsive to all flesh!”</dq>

readings.title: The Annals of Ḥizqiyahu
readings.subtitle: The recorded historical acts and water channels of the sovereign of Yehuḏah.
readings.text: [2 Kings 20:20] And the rest of the acts of Ḥizqiyahu, and all his might and how he made <dn>את</dn> a pool and <dn>את</dn> a channel and brought <dn>את</dn> water into the city, are they not written in the book of the annals of the sovereigns of Yehuḏah? [21] So Ḥizqiyahu slept with his fathers. And Menashsheh his son reigned in his place.

readings.title: Ḥizqiyahu’s Legacy of Loving-Commitment
readings.subtitle: The final rest of a faithful king, honored in the vision of Yeshayahu and the records of the nation.
readings.text: [2 Chronicles 32:32] And the rest of the acts of Ḥizqiyahu, and his loving-commitment, see, they are written in the vision of Yeshayahu the prophet, son of Amots, in the book of the sovereigns of Yehuḏah and Yisra’ěl. [33] So Ḥizqiyahu slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the upper burial-sites of the sons of Daviḏ. And all Yehuḏah and the inhabitants of Yerushalayim esteemed him at his death. And Menashsheh his son reigned in his place.
